title: Third time lucky at the Oval.
deck: A first FA Cup, before Wembley became the final’s home.
body: After defeats in the 1886 and 1887 finals, Albion finally lifted the FA Cup in 1888, beating Preston North End 2–1. The winning side belongs to the era of the Oval, long before Wembley became part of cup-final tradition.

That same year, Albion joined the 12 founder members of the Football League. The cup-winning photograph captures a team standing at the beginning of both the club’s trophy story and the league game familiar to supporters today.
